message.content: In the discussions, several PS5 exclusives are mentioned as upcoming releases. One of the primary topics revolves around a new game that is set to drop soon on both the PS digital store and physical disc, according to Thane Chambers. This game is likely to be a PS5 exclusive, given the emphasis on a potential group purchase and the excitement expressed by the group members. Additionally, Thane Chambers mentions "Spider-Man: Miles Morales" as a game that Li Hua is interested in purchasing, suggesting that this might be one of the upcoming PS5 exclusives. Another game that seems to be generating interest among the group is "Demon's Souls," which Thane Chambers recommends as a challenging yet rewarding title for PS5 fans.
